topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: You'd think in this part of town, money'd be as common as rain, but it's the surprises that make the gut tighten. This neighbor, always seemed like another flat shadow, always bustlin' in and out, nothing special. Then comes the whispers, faint at first, over the fence from Maureen. Turns out, our pal’s got a vault in the ground, as deep as the secrets he keeps. Every click of the heels on the pavement now sounds a bit heavier, a bit more deliberate. People change when they find out they’re not as poor as they thought, and the walls around here, thin as they are, don't keep out all the noise. I still haven’t decided if it’s better to know the truth or be left in the cold, dark quiet.
